description: This file defines the ReviewListAPI class for the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It provides an API endpoint to list performance review records with filtering, sorting, and pagination features. The class extends PerformanceReviewAPI and utilizes traits for authentication and service logic. It includes annotations for API documentation with OpenAPI/Swagger syntax.
